purpose: Owner-authorized, opt-in presentation output that identifies the full canonical paths of selected-root regular files from which the scanner extracted one or more candidate values.
invocation: classifier-cli scan ... --show-paths; the direct CLI remains aggregate-only without this flag
boundaries: path disclosure is limited to the explicit selected root and only files with one or more extracted candidates
no candidate values, context, fingerprints, logits, probabilities, confidence, policy decision, or source contents
no path persistence, telemetry, remote access, execution, or runtime network
presentation paths are operator-requested and must not be collected in default aggregate reports
